description: Header file defining classes and functions for Ethernet transceiver emulation in a RU emulator, supporting DPDK and socket-based implementations.

classes.name: ru_emulator_transceiver
classes.description: Encapsulates Ethernet transmitter and receiver functionalities used by the RU emulator.

classes.name: ru_emu_dpdk_receiver
classes.description: Ethernet receiver implementation based on DPDK library.

classes.name: ru_emu_dpdk_transmitter
classes.description: Ethernet transmitter implementation based on DPDK library.

classes.name: ru_emu_socket_receiver
classes.description: Ethernet receiver implementation based on UNIX sockets.

classes.name: ru_emu_socket_transmitter
classes.description: Ethernet transmitter implementation based on UNIX sockets.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends frames through the Ethernet link.

methods.name: get_operation_controller
methods.description: Returns the receiver operation controller interface.
